content.title: Las Vegas Sands, MGM, Wynn Stocks Decline. Why Shares of Casino Operators Are Falling.
content.summary: Shares of  Las Vegas Sands  and other casino operators slid on Friday as investors feared softer-than-expected travel data could have a bearing on business in Macau.  China’s ministry of tourism earlier this week released passenger data for the first two days of Golden Week, a national holiday meant to encourage domestic travel and stimulate the economy.  “Overall passenger throughput volume during first two days could be below some investors’ expectations, which we partially attribute to more people starting their travel earlier this year,” analysts posited.
